text:
## Transaction Monitoring  
### Purpose  
Detect suspicious transaction patterns indicative of money laundering or terrorist financing.
name: Chunk 13/35

raw_entities.name: Transaction Monitoring Policy
raw_entities.description: A policy governing the detection and monitoring of suspicious transaction patterns indicative of money laundering or terrorist financing activities. The policy establishes the framework for identifying and responding to transactions that may indicate financial crime.
context: Detect suspicious transaction patterns indicative of money laundering or terrorist financing

raw_entities.name: Money Laundering
raw_entities.description: The risk of customer accounts and transactions being used to conceal the origins of illegally obtained funds. This is a primary focus of the transaction monitoring policy.
context: Detect suspicious transaction patterns indicative of money laundering or terrorist financing

raw_entities.name: Terrorist Financing
raw_entities.description: The risk of customer accounts and transactions being used to fund terrorist activities or organizations. This is a primary focus of the transaction monitoring policy.
context: Detect suspicious transaction patterns indicative of money laundering or terrorist financing

raw_entities.name: Transaction Monitoring System
raw_entities.description: An operational control mechanism designed to detect and flag suspicious transaction patterns that may indicate money laundering or terrorist financing. The system monitors transactions to identify anomalies and high-risk activities.
context: Detect suspicious transaction patterns indicative of money laundering or terrorist financing
